CONTRADICTION - location: Nextdoor and GoSimples give 91 Wimpole Street (Marylebone); mortgage118 files the firm under Hackney, yet all share postcode W1G 0EF.

CONTRADICTION (minor) - Africa coverage wording: 'South Africa' (Trustpilot) vs 'South & West Africa' (LinkedIn) vs 'southern Africa' (2020 press).
